svg.title: The ledger and its views
svg.desc: The ledger holds two standing claims: the invariant invoices-final, an issued invoice is never edited, and the assumption one-currency, every order is in one currency. An agent runs boom propose, and event 3 proposes the invariant billing-owns-invoices, only billing writes invoices; its status reads proposed. A person, Ada, runs boom accept, and event 4 accepts it; its status now reads standing. The views are computed again from the ledger: the rules for a scope list two invariants, and boom check reads two standing claims. An agent then proposes the decision money-has-currency, every amount carries its currency, which supersedes one-currency, and Ada accepts it. one-currency reads superseded, the decision records gain docs/adr/0001-money-has-currency.md, and boom check reads three standing claims. The design book and the context map are computed the same way. No status is stored and no event is edited.

g.text: invariant · An issued invoice is never edited.
assumption · Every order is in one currency.
decision · Every amount carries its currency.
A person accepts it: it stands.
A new claim supersedes an old one.
